purpose: 复用原八对照/原标签及全部1212原成熟池，只新增原贷款总体需求百分数；一次1212树+1212岭，无调参
executed_source:
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
import json,hashlib
import numpy as np,pandas as pd
from sklearn.tree import DecisionTreeRegressor
ROOT=Path.cwd();R='reports/research/510300_bankers_loan_demand_joint_score_v1';OUT=ROOT/R
def now():return datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat()
def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def readj(p):return json.loads((ROOT/p).read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
def save_new(name,obj):
    p=OUT/name;assert not p.exists(),'已存在不覆盖：'+name
    p.write_text(json.dumps(obj,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
def fnum(v):return float(v) if np.isfinite(v) else None
assert not (OUT/'result.json').exists() and not (OUT/'每日贷款需求联合评分.csv').exists()
proto=readj(R+'/protocol.json');plan=proto['fixed_model_plan']
for x in proto['parents']+proto['source_stage_outputs']:
    assert sha(ROOT/x['path'])==x['sha256'],'已登记输入变化：'+x['path']
d=pd.read_parquet(ROOT/'reports/research/510300_purchase_quantity_cause_increment_v1/原八变量与采购两列_原标签不变.parquet')
source=pd.read_parquet(ROOT/'reports/research/510300_bankers_loan_demand_source_qualification_v1/原八字段与贷款总体需求_未读股票标签_v1_0_1.parquet')
assert np.array_equal(source.idx.to_numpy(),d.idx.to_numpy())
pd.testing.assert_frame_equal(d[['idx','date','decision_time','orders_available_at','funding_available_at','valid_features','exit_idx']+plan['features8_reused']],source[['idx','date','decision_time','orders_available_at','funding_available_at','valid_features','exit_idx']+plan['features8_reused']],check_exact=True)
for c in plan['added_features']+['贷款需求原公布可知时间']:d[c]=source[c].to_numpy()
pools=readj('reports/research/510300_daily_score_financing_input_correction_v1/共同成熟训练池.json');poolby={int(z['idx']):z for z in pools}
d.to_parquet(OUT/'原八字段与贷款总体需求_原标签不变.parquet',index=False)
base=pd.read_csv(ROOT/'reports/research/510300_daily_score_financing_input_correction_v1/纠错8变量每日联合评分.csv')
base['date']=pd.to_datetime(base['date'])
assert len(base)==1212 and np.array_equal(d.index.to_numpy(),d.idx.to_numpy())
features=plan['features8_reused']+plan['added_features']
rows=[];models=[];fits=0
for rr in base.itertuples(index=False):
    i=int(rr.idx)
    pool=d[(d.idx>=i-504)&(d.exit_idx<=i)&d.valid_features&d.net_label.notna()]
    assert len(pool)==int(rr.n_train)>=252 and int(pool.exit_idx.max())==int(rr.max_label_exit_idx)
    assert pool.idx.astype(int).tolist()==poolby[i]['training_indices']
    x=pool[features].to_numpy(float);y=pool.net_label.to_numpy(float)
    current=d.loc[i,features].to_numpy(float).reshape(1,-1)
    assert np.isfinite(x).all() and np.isfinite(current).all()
    model=DecisionTreeRegressor(**plan['tree'])
    model.fit(x,y);fits+=1
    pred=float(model.predict(current)[0]);tp=model.predict(x)
    score=float(100*((tp<pred).mean()+0.5*(tp==pred).mean()))
    mean=x.mean(axis=0);scale=x.std(axis=0,ddof=1);scale[scale<1e-12]=1.
    z=np.clip((x-mean)/scale,-5,5);zm=z.mean(axis=0);center=z-zm
    coef=np.linalg.solve(center.T@center+10*np.eye(len(features)),center.T@(y-y.mean()));fits+=1
    lin=float(y.mean()+(np.clip((current[0]-mean)/scale,-5,5)-zm)@coef)
    assert np.isclose(float(y.mean()),float(rr.mean_prediction),rtol=0,atol=1e-15)
    pathnodes=model.decision_path(current).indices
    actual_used=[features[int(model.tree_.feature[n])] for n in pathnodes if model.tree_.feature[n]>=0]
    added_path=[s for s in actual_used if s in plan['added_features']]
    row={'idx':i,'date':pd.Timestamp(rr.date),'n_train':len(pool),
      'max_label_exit_idx':int(pool.exit_idx.max()),'score':score,'score_bin':min(int(score//20),4),
      'nonlinear_prediction':pred,'linear_prediction':lin,'mean_prediction':float(y.mean()),
      'control_nonlinear_prediction':float(rr.nonlinear_prediction),
      'control_linear_prediction':float(rr.linear_prediction),'control_score':float(rr.score),
      'actual_net5':float(rr.actual_net5),'era':rr.era,
      'added_field_on_actual_path':bool(added_path),'actual_path_features':'、'.join(actual_used),
      'added_path_features':'、'.join(added_path)}
    rows.append(row)
    models.append({'idx':i,'date':str(pd.Timestamp(rr.date)),'features':features,'n_train':len(pool),
      'max_label_exit_idx':int(pool.exit_idx.max()),'tree_children_left':model.tree_.children_left.tolist(),
      'tree_children_right':model.tree_.children_right.tolist(),'tree_feature':model.tree_.feature.tolist(),
      'tree_threshold':model.tree_.threshold.tolist(),'tree_value':model.tree_.value.ravel().tolist(),
      'tree_samples':model.tree_.n_node_samples.tolist(),'linear_coefficients':coef.tolist(),
      'linear_mean':mean.tolist(),'linear_scale':scale.tolist(),'linear_zmean':zm.tolist(),
      'training_target_mean':float(y.mean()),'actual_path_features':actual_used})
    if len(rows)%300==0:print('已完成原固定评分日：'+str(len(rows))+'，新增拟合：'+str(fits),flush=True)
p=pd.DataFrame(rows)
assert len(p)==1212 and fits==2424
assert np.array_equal(p.idx.to_numpy(),base.idx.to_numpy()) and (p.max_label_exit_idx<=p.idx).all()
assert np.allclose(p.actual_net5.to_numpy(),base.actual_net5.to_numpy(),rtol=0,atol=0)
comparisons=[];buckets=[]
for era,block in p.groupby('era',sort=False):
    for label,col in [('同池均值','mean_prediction'),('原八变量岭','control_linear_prediction'),('原八变量树','control_nonlinear_prediction'),('贷款需求九变量岭','linear_prediction'),('贷款需求九变量树','nonlinear_prediction')]:
        comparisons.append({'era':era,'model':label,'days':len(block),'mse':float(((block[col]-block.actual_net5)**2).mean())})
    for bucket in range(5):
        b=block[block.score_bin==bucket]
        win=b.loc[b.actual_net5>0,'actual_net5'];loss=b.loc[b.actual_net5<0,'actual_net5']
        buckets.append({'era':era,'score_band':str(bucket*20)+'—'+str((bucket+1)*20),
         'n':len(b),'mean_net5':fnum(b.actual_net5.mean()),'median_net5':fnum(b.actual_net5.median()),
         'win_rate':fnum((b.actual_net5>0).mean()) if len(b) else None,
         'realized_return_payoff':fnum(win.mean()/-loss.mean()) if len(win) and len(loss) else None})
def opportunities(frame,scorecol,predcol,name):
    result=[];next_decision=-1
    for r in frame.itertuples(index=False):
        sc=float(getattr(r,scorecol));pr=float(getattr(r,predcol))
        if r.idx<next_decision or sc<80 or pr<=0 or not np.isfinite(r.actual_net5):continue
        result.append({'model':name,'era':r.era,'idx':int(r.idx),'signal_date':str(pd.Timestamp(r.date).date()),
          'entry_date':str(pd.Timestamp(d.date.iloc[r.idx+1]).date()),
          'exit_date':str(pd.Timestamp(d.date.iloc[r.idx+6]).date()),'score':sc,'prediction':pr,
          'net_event_return':float(r.actual_net5),
          'actual_added_path':bool(r.added_field_on_actual_path) if name=='贷款需求九变量' else False,
          'path':r.actual_path_features if name=='贷款需求九变量' else '原保存八变量',
          'entry_idx':int(r.idx)+1,'exit_idx':int(r.idx)+6})
        next_decision=int(r.idx)+6
    return result
candidate=opportunities(p,'score','nonlinear_prediction','贷款需求九变量')
control=opportunities(p,'control_score','control_nonlinear_prediction','原纠错八变量')
assert len([r for r in control if r['era']=='2024—2025'])==9
cmain=[r for r in candidate if r['era']=='2024—2025']
bmain=[r for r in control if r['era']=='2024—2025']
m={r['model']:r['mse'] for r in comparisons if r['era']=='2024—2025'}
new_dates=sorted({r['signal_date'] for r in cmain}-{r['signal_date'] for r in bmain})
cmean=float(np.mean([r['net_event_return'] for r in cmain])) if cmain else float('nan')
gates={'primary_tree_mse_below_corrected8':m['贷款需求九变量树']<m['原八变量树'],
 'primary_tree_mse_below_same_pool_mean':m['贷款需求九变量树']<m['同池均值'],
 'primary_fixed_high_score_mean_net_positive':bool(cmain) and cmean>0,
 'at_least_one_new_primary_natural_date':bool(new_dates),
 'added_fields_on_primary_high_score_actual_path':any(r['actual_added_path'] for r in cmain)}
passgate=all(gates.values())
period_summaries=[]
for era in ('2021—2023','2024—2025'):
    ce=[r for r in candidate if r['era']==era];be=[r for r in control if r['era']==era]
    block=p[p.era==era]
    cvals=np.array([r['net_event_return'] for r in ce],float)
    bvals=np.array([r['net_event_return'] for r in be],float)
    period_summaries.append({'era':era,'candidate_events':len(ce),'control_events':len(be),
     'candidate_mean_net5':fnum(cvals.mean()) if len(ce) else None,
     'control_mean_net5':fnum(bvals.mean()) if len(be) else None,
     'candidate_win_rate':float((cvals>0).mean()) if len(ce) else None,
     'candidate_actual_loan_demand_path_events':sum(r['actual_added_path'] for r in ce),
     'prediction_changed_days':int((np.abs(block.nonlinear_prediction-block.control_nonlinear_prediction)>1e-15).sum()),
     'candidate_mean_prediction':float(block.nonlinear_prediction.mean()),
     'primary_path_use_days':int(block.added_field_on_actual_path.sum())})
p.to_csv(OUT/'每日贷款需求联合评分.csv',index=False,encoding='utf-8-sig')
save_new('保存贷款需求九变量模型.json',models)
pd.DataFrame(comparisons).to_csv(OUT/'同日同池五项误差比较.csv',index=False,encoding='utf-8-sig')
pd.DataFrame(buckets).to_csv(OUT/'全部原五分档结果.csv',index=False,encoding='utf-8-sig')
pd.DataFrame(candidate+control).to_csv(OUT/'两模型全部自然高分机会.csv',index=False,encoding='utf-8-sig')
yearly=[]
for name,events in [('贷款需求九变量',candidate),('原纠错八变量',control)]:
    for year in range(2021,2026):
        a=[r for r in events if r['entry_date'].startswith(str(year))]
        yearly.append({'model':name,'year':year,'count_basis':'entry_year_natural_completed_5day_events_not_account_cycles','natural_opportunities':len(a),
         'mean_net5':fnum(np.mean([r['net_event_return'] for r in a])) if a else None})
pd.DataFrame(yearly).to_csv(OUT/'逐年自然机会.csv',index=False,encoding='utf-8-sig')
save_new('trial_accounting.json',{'one_economic_candidate':True,'parameters_changed':False,
 'new_tree_fits':1212,'new_ridge_comparator_fits':1212,'reused_baseline_days':1212,
 'baseline_refits':0,'new_labels':0,'new_accounts':0,'source_code_edits':0})
status='COMPLETED_FIXED_BANKERS_LOAN_DEMAND_INCREMENT_PRIMARY_GATE_PASSED_ACCOUNT_NOT_RUN' if passgate else 'REJECTED_FROZEN_FIXED_BANKERS_OVERALL_LOAN_DEMAND_CONDITION_NO_PRIMARY_INCREMENT'
result={'study_id':proto['study_id'],'experiment_id':'E78','completed_at':now(),'status':status,
 'classification':'PROGRESS_E78_FIXED_BANKERS_OVERALL_LOAN_DEMAND_JOINT_SCORE_COMPLETED',
 'source_original_quarters':29,'source_gate':proto['source_gate'],'score_days':1212,'primary_days':485,'earlier_days':727,
 'features':features,'new_source_requests':0,'new_labels':0,'new_fits':fits,
 'new_tree_fits':1212,'new_ridge_comparator_fits':1212,'baseline_refits':0,
 'new_full_accounts':0,'source_code_edits':0,'parameter_grids':0,
 'comparisons':comparisons,'period_summaries':period_summaries,'fixed_primary_gates':gates,
 'primary_increment_gate_passed':passgate,'primary_tree_mse_change_vs_control_fraction':m['贷款需求九变量树']/m['原八变量树']-1,
 'primary_new_natural_high_score_dates':new_dates,'primary_candidate_high_score_net_mean':fnum(cmean),
 'account_status':'NOT_RUN_SCORE_EXPERIMENT_ACCOUNT_NOT_REGISTERED' if passgate else 'NOT_RUN_FIXED_PRIMARY_INCREMENT_GATE_FAILED',
 'net_sharpe':'NOT_COMPUTED','goal_achieved':False,'independent_validation':'NOT_ESTABLISHED_ALREADY_OBSERVED_HISTORY',
 'historical_first_vintage_authenticated':False,'market_expectation_surprise':'NOT_IDENTIFIED',
 'loan_demand_state_causal_equity_effect':'NOT_IDENTIFIED','current_view':'NO_VIEW','position':'UNSET',
 'orders_authorized':False,'new_prospective_forecasts_enabled':False,
 'old_cpi_inventory_sfisf_and_original_score_rejections_preserved':True,
 'facts_report':R+'/贷款总体需求联合评分_固定结果.md'}
save_new('result.json',result)
saved=pd.read_csv(OUT/'每日贷款需求联合评分.csv')
saved_metrics=pd.read_csv(OUT/'同日同池五项误差比较.csv')
saved_events=pd.read_csv(OUT/'两模型全部自然高分机会.csv')
assert len(saved)==1212 and len(saved_metrics)==10 and len(saved_events)==len(candidate)+len(control)
for r in comparisons:
    got=saved[saved.era==r['era']]
    col={'同池均值':'mean_prediction','原八变量岭':'control_linear_prediction',
      '原八变量树':'control_nonlinear_prediction','贷款需求九变量岭':'linear_prediction','贷款需求九变量树':'nonlinear_prediction'}[r['model']]
    assert np.isclose(float(((got[col]-got.actual_net5)**2).mean()),r['mse'],rtol=0,atol=1e-15)
assert (saved.max_label_exit_idx<=saved.idx).all()
for x in proto['parents']+proto['source_stage_outputs']:assert sha(ROOT/x['path'])==x['sha256']
save_new('保存结果必要核对.json',{'status':'PASS_FIXED_SOURCE_POOL_LABELS_COUNTS_AND_SAVED_METRICS',
 'checked_at':now(),'score_days':1212,'new_fits':2424,'original_labels_unchanged':True,
 'original_mature_members_unchanged':True,'baseline_predictions_reused':True,
 'all_five_bands_and_two_eras_retained':True,'saved_error_rows_recomputed':10,
 'saved_natural_events':len(saved_events),'source_and_model_parents_unchanged':True,
 'first_vintage_authenticated':False,'independent_validation':False,'new_accounts':0,'source_code_edits':0})
report=['# E78：贷款总体需求原状态加入原八联合模型的固定比较','',
'新增唯一贷款总体需求指数原百分数：银行家对本行本季贷款需求增长的占比加基本不变占比的一半。它是主观扩散状态，不是贷款数量、股市资金流、纯需求冲击或精确预期差。与原订单、资金价格、融资、趋势、波动和成交条件一起由固定浅树估计，未预设线性符号。','',
'E77全部29当前原报告/方法/真实目录公布钟、1711成员和1212原成熟池全齐。2020Q4同一原PDF文字重字导致自动提取失败，原失败及程序保持，金融使用前按原第1/2/4页完整目视补71.6及原方法；其余28字段/时钟不动。当前原链接及元日期未见已知晚版本的保守历史重构，首版和真正第一次公开仍未认证。','',
'原深3叶60/seed20261001、504/252、岭10、原五日费用/分红标签、80分且预测正、自然不重叠规则保持。两期五档全报，一次2424新拟合；原八/均值复用，基线0重拟合。新参数网格/网络/标签/账户/源码修改0。','',
'| 固定时期 | 原八自然机会 | 新需求九变量机会 | 原平均净5日 | 新平均净5日 | 新胜率 | 高分实际需求字段路径 |',
'|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|']
for s in period_summaries:
 fmt=lambda v:'未定义' if v is None else f'{v:.6%}'
 report.append('|'+s['era']+'|'+str(s['control_events'])+'|'+str(s['candidate_events'])+'|'+fmt(s['control_mean_net5'])+'|'+fmt(s['candidate_mean_net5'])+'|'+fmt(s['candidate_win_rate'])+'|'+str(s['candidate_actual_loan_demand_path_events'])+'|')
report+=['','主期树MSE相对原八变化 '+f"{result['primary_tree_mse_change_vs_control_fraction']:.6%}"+'。',
 '','固定五门：'+json.dumps(gates,ensure_ascii=False)+'。','','结果：'+status+'。',
 '','来源成立不是经济增量成立；自然机会不是完整账户。五门未全过则此固定需求表达拒绝，下一只对全部机会信号/费用/实际原叶作保存诊断，不换同比/差分/季节模型/阈值/持有期/时期或费用救回。五门全过才另登记完整账户。夏普NOT_COMPUTED、全部历史已见、独立验证未建、完整目标未达。',
 '','[登记协议](protocol.json)、[原来源](../510300_bankers_loan_demand_source_qualification_v1/source_gate_v1_0_1.json)、[全部误差](同日同池五项误差比较.csv)、[全部两期五档](全部原五分档结果.csv)、[全部自然机会](两模型全部自然高分机会.csv)、[实际结果](result.json)、[必要保存核对](保存结果必要核对.json)。']
(OUT/'贷款总体需求联合评分_固定结果.md').write_text('\n'.join(report)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps({'状态':status,'主期误差变化':result['primary_tree_mse_change_vs_control_fraction'],'固定五门':gates,'分期结果':period_summaries,'新拟合':fits,'新账户':0,'目标':False},ensure_ascii=False))
